```{python}
import palantir
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import os

# Plotting
import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
carpall = sc.read("carpall_scvi_integrated.h5ad")
sc.pl.umap(carpall, color="leiden_res_0.7", legend_loc="on data")
to_remove = ["18", "19", "20", "8"]
carpall = carpall[~carpall.obs["leiden_res_0.7"].isin(to_remove)].copy()
sc.pl.umap(carpall, color="leiden_res_0.7")
```

```{python}
dm_res = palantir.utils.run_diffusion_maps(carpall, n_components=5)
dm_res
```

```{python}
ms_data = palantir.utils.determine_multiscale_space(carpall)
ms_data
```

```{python}
imputed_X = palantir.utils.run_magic_imputation(carpall)
```
